title: HSTU session-context Mirror views for logical user preferences
status: NOT ESTABLISHED — environment blocker; registry remains UNTESTED
hypothesis: Adding a small session-context m to a shared HSTU readout yields useful multiobjective user-preference functions without duplicating HSTU parameters or history state, at matched recommendation quality and serving cost.
physical_object: One HSTU sequential recommendation model and its user interaction history/cache.
mirror_coordinate: A compact session-context code m supplied to the native HSTU readout.
controls: shared HSTU with ordinary session embedding/gate or low-rank readout

development.selection_metric: No development run: required HSTU training/inference stack unavailable.

success_gate: Fresh time-ordered recommendation evaluation must show useful objective-specific quality at matched or improved serialized payload and serving latency versus native HSTU and the cheapest ordinary embedding/gate/low-rank control.
failure_gate: Mirror fails if a simple session embedding/gate matches its quality at equal or lower bytes/latency, or if quality gains require duplicated history/model state that removes the Pareto benefit.
boundaries: This candidate was randomly selected as draw 15, pool size 536, zero-based index 56.
No training, development, fresh or audit examples were opened.
Environment capability check: torch/tensorflow/jax/transformers/datasets absent; nvidia-smi/nvcc absent.
No HSTU implementation/checkpoint or recommendation dataset was present in the workspace.
Do not substitute a toy sequence model; it would not reproduce PA342 HSTU behavior.
